current.text: Meleek Thomas is a 20-year-old rookie. Cleveland took him 34th in the second round after trading back from pick 29.
He has no clear role right now. James Harden and Donovan Mitchell fill the backcourt. He is not in the projected starting lineup or the projected bench of Tyson, Merrill, Bryant, Tomlin and Porter.
Experts are unsure how he fits in the rotation at first.
He was the top-ranked fantasy player of summer league. He averaged 26 points, 4 assists and 2 steals, shooting 50% from the field and 44% from three.
One expert expects him to be a 27-minute third guard within two years.
Several experts rate him well above his draft slot. One called him one of the biggest risers versus his slot, and one called the pick a swindle for Cleveland.
His body still needs physical development.

durable.text: He is a guard from Arkansas with good size. In college he shot 42% on threes with good two-point and free-throw percentages.
Experts expect him to pass more and defend solidly in the NBA. They also say playing next to high-usage Darius Acuff held his college numbers down.
Experts project him as a starting-caliber NBA player in the long term.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Blocked by James Harden and Donovan Mitchell. He is not in the projected rotation

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 614th. It projects 5.6 points in 47 games, so he is nowhere near the 144 players drafted in our league and should not be drafted. His strong summer league line shows upside, but experts see his value as long-term. Early in the season, check whether an injury to Harden or Mitchell or Cleveland's thin bench gives him real minutes before you look at him on waivers.
